theme: SWISS & HIGH-CONTRAST (Authority, Clarity, Truth) mixed with Technical Blueprint
vibe: A hyper-modern, brutalist yet precise engineering manual. It should feel authoritative, technical, and structural. Instead of generic AI purple gradients or dark mode, it uses stark light-mode contrasts, visible grids, and striking typography to feel like a high-end technical document.

background.description: Warm paper/bone white. Gives a physical, organic touch to the digital space.

accent.primary_description: International Klein Blue. Use strictly for primary CTAs, active states, and progress bars. High impact.
accent.highlight_description: Highlighter Yellow. Use for active text selection or highlighting key AI definitions.

typography.heading_strategy: High impact, wide, tight tracking. Never center headings unless for specific hero balance. Use tracking-tighter.
typography.body_strategy: Sterile, monospaced font for all body text, labels, metadata, and difficulty badges to emphasize the 'engineering' aspect.

visual_enhancers.borders: Expose the skeleton. Use 1px hard borders (border-black) for cards and buttons. Use subtle borders (border-neutral-300) for grid dividers.
visual_enhancers.shadows: Hard, brutalist shadows. shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] instead of soft blurs. Creates a tactile, 'stamped' feel.
visual_enhancers.radius: No rounded corners. rounded-none for a sharp, precise, paper-like aesthetic.
visual_enhancers.textures: Optional subtle SVG noise overlay fixed at z-0 with 3% opacity to kill the digital flatness.

cards.style: bg-white border border-black shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)] p-6 sm:p-8 rounded-none transition-transform hover:-translate-y-1 hover:translate-x-1 hover:shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(17,17,17,1)]

buttons.primary: bg-[#002FA7] text-white px-6 py-3 font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-black transition-colors rounded-none
buttons.secondary: bg-transparent border border-black text-black px-6 py-3 font-mono text-sm uppercase tracking-widest hover:bg-[#FAFF00] transition-colors rounded-none

badges.style: inline-block border border-black px-2 py-1 text-xs font-mono uppercase tracking-wider bg-[#EAEAEA]

ai_chat_tutor.style: bg-[#111111] text-[#F4F4F0] p-6 font-mono text-sm border border-black shadow-[8px_8px_0px_0px_rgba(0,47,167,1)]
ai_chat_tutor.input: bg-transparent border-b border-neutral-700 focus:border-white w-full py-2 outline-none

grids_and_layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy. Use p-8, p-12, p-16. Never cramp content. Cards must have internal p-6 or p-8.
grids_and_layouts.dashboard_grid: The 'Technical' Look. Use a CSS grid with border-collapse, exposing grid lines between modules.
grids_and_layouts.hero: Asymmetrical split layout. Left side: Massive typography, progress tracker. Right side: The Live AI Tutor interactive console.
grids_and_layouts.module_grid: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-3 gap-8. Direct children must be the card elements.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp and mechanical. Buttons turn highlighter yellow or solid black instantly. Cards translate aggressively with solid shadow growth.
motion_and_interaction.transitions: transition-all duration-200 ease-in-out. Avoid sluggish 500ms fades.
motion_and_interaction.ai_typing: Use a blinking cursor block `█` for the AI chat stream to mimic a terminal.

accessibility.contrast: Extremely high contrast. Black on white, white on black, blue on white.
accessibility.motion: Respect prefers-reduced-motion for the card hover translations.

hero_accent.description: Abstract steel structure with futuristic geometric patterns. Use as a masked overlay, hero background accent, or decorative structural image in the hero section.

concept_accent.description: Geometric object with concrete top and twisted copper base. Use for the 'Capstone/Interview Prep' card or 'Foundations' module visual.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install required fonts: Cabinet Grotesk (from Fontshare or local assets) and JetBrains Mono (from Google Fonts).
Use Phosphor Icons (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react) with a 'bold' or 'fill' weight to match the brutalist aesthetic.
Do NOT use Shadcn's default Card component if it forces border-radius and soft shadows. Build custom raw HTML/Tailwind cards using the rules in 'components.cards'.
Implement the Live AI Chat Tutor as a hero interactive feature. Give it a deep dark terminal vibe (#111111) to contrast aggressively with the off-white page background.
Add 'data-testid' to all progress bars, module cards, flashcard toggle buttons, and AI chat inputs.
Implement local storage for progress tracking without requiring login.
Organize the 11 modules into a high-density grid. Ensure each has a difficulty badge and click-to-expand functionality for topics/definitions.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Avoid the 'AI slop' aesthetic. Do NOT use purple-to-blue gradients, glowing orbs, or standard SaaS blue.
You MUST NOT apply universal transitions (e.g., transition: all). Add transitions for specific interactive elements only.
You MUST NOT center align the app container. Keep a left-aligned, highly structured, grid-based reading flow.
Use hard, sharp shadows (e.g., shadow-[4px_4px_0px_0px_rgba(0,0,0,1)]) instead of soft, blurred shadows.
Prioritize using pre-existing components from src/components/ui when applicable, but strip away any soft rounded corners (rounded-lg) to adhere to the brutalist sharp aesthetic (rounded-none).
Use sonner for toasts, but override the style to match the sharp, high-contrast borders.
